digits.description: Fires on every token that is a number written in digits.

the.description: Fires on every occurrence of the word 'the' or 'The'.

capitalised word.description: Fires on every capitalised word (a word starting with a capital letter) that follows a space.

of.description: Fires on every occurrence of the word 'of'.

full stop.description: Fires on every full stop (period) that is its own token.

and.description: Fires on every occurrence of the word 'and'.

is/are/was/were.description: Fires on every occurrence of the words 'is', 'are', 'was' or 'were'.

in.description: Fires on every occurrence of the word 'in'.

pronoun.description: Fires on every occurrence of the pronouns he, she, they or it.
